Adapted from [Campbell's Iconic Green Bean Casserole](https://www.campbells.com/recipes/green-bean-casserole/) by Campbell's Test Kitchen, Campbell's.

**Yield:** 6 servings · **Prep:** 10 min · **Cook:** 30 min

## Ingredients

- 1 can (10.5 ounces) condensed cream of mushroom soup
- ½ cup 2% milk
- 1 teaspoon soy sauce
- 4 cups cooked cut green beans
- 1 ⅓ cups French fried onions, divided
- salt and pepper

## Method

1. Heat the oven to 350°F.
2. In a 1 ½-quart casserole, stir together the soup, milk, soy sauce, green beans and ⅔ cup of the fried onions. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Bake for 25 minutes, until hot and bubbling, then stir.
4. Sprinkle the remaining ⅔ cup of onions over the top and bake 5 minutes more, until the onions are golden brown.
5. Let it rest a few minutes before serving.

## Notes

- For the 4 cups of beans the source gives three routes: about 1 ½ pounds fresh, blanched 2 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender; 16 to 20 ounces frozen, thawed; or 2 cans (14.5 ounces each), drained. It prefers fresh.
- Leftovers reheat at 350°F; freeze without the onion topping for up to 2 months and thaw overnight in the fridge.
